headline: Knee-high, short and clean early — a morning longboard tide-and-go.
today: Small S swell at a good angle for Lido but only 4-plus seconds, so it's log fuel at best. N offshore in the morning keeps it groomed; ride the early hours before the SSW onshore turns it to slop in the afternoon. Fun-size for a mellow paddle, nothing more.

daysToWatch.note: S onshore building 22-25mph. Blown out, write it off.
The one to circle — 2.3-3ft on a good S angle with NW-to-N offshore all day. Short period so it won't be perfect, but clean and the size of the week. Shortboard or fish, work the morning.
